description:
Expected EMIs, totals and yearly figures come from the suite's own amortisation
  (framework/oracles/emi.ts), so the app cannot agree with itself. The EMI is also
  written out below, rounded to the rupee as the app shows it, so it can be checked by hand.

steps.name: I open the LoanLens EMI calculator
I enter a loan of "25L" at 10% for 10 years
the monthly EMI should read "₹33,038"
the monthly EMI, total interest and total payment should match my own calculation
the yearly payments chart should show one non-zero bar per loan year
every yearly bar should match my own amortisation
I capture evidence "25L at 10% for 10 years"
I open the LoanLens EMI calculator
I enter a loan of "50L" at 7.5% for 15 years
the monthly EMI should read "₹46,351"
the monthly EMI, total interest and total payment should match my own calculation
the yearly payments chart should show one non-zero bar per loan year
every yearly bar should match my own amortisation
I capture evidence "50L at 7.5% for 15 years"
I open the LoanLens EMI calculator
I enter a loan of "10L" at 12% for 5 years
the monthly EMI should read "₹22,244"
the monthly EMI, total interest and total payment should match my own calculation
the yearly payments chart should show one non-zero bar per loan year
every yearly bar should match my own amortisation
I capture evidence "10L at 12% for 5 years"

elements.name: A negative loan amount is refused

steps.name: I open the LoanLens EMI calculator
I enter a loan of "25L" at 10% for 10 years
I type "-2383434" into the "Loan amount" box
the "Loan amount" box should show the error "Loan amount must be between ₹1,000 and ₹10,00,00,000."
the repayment summary and the chart should be hidden
I capture evidence "A negative loan amount"
I type "2000000" into the "Loan amount" box
the monthly EMI, total interest and total payment should match my own calculation

elements.name: An empty loan amount is refused

steps.name: I open the LoanLens EMI calculator
I enter a loan of "25L" at 10% for 10 years
I type "" into the "Loan amount" box
the "Loan amount" box should show the error "Enter a loan amount in rupees."
the repayment summary and the chart should be hidden
I capture evidence "An empty loan amount"
I type "3000000" into the "Loan amount" box
the monthly EMI, total interest and total payment should match my own calculation

elements.name: An amount in exponent form is refused

steps.name: I open the LoanLens EMI calculator
I enter a loan of "25L" at 10% for 10 years
I type "1e6" into the "Loan amount" box
the "Loan amount" box should show the error "Loan amount must be written in plain digits, for example 2500000."
the repayment summary and the chart should be hidden
I capture evidence "An amount in exponent form"
I type "2000000" into the "Loan amount" box
the monthly EMI, total interest and total payment should match my own calculation

elements.name: A tenure longer than 40 years is refused

steps.name: I open the LoanLens EMI calculator
I enter a loan of "25L" at 10% for 10 years
I type "50" into the "Loan tenure" box
the "Loan tenure" box should show the error "Loan tenure must be a whole number of years between 1 and 40."
the repayment summary and the chart should be hidden
I capture evidence "A tenure longer than 40 years"
I type "20" into the "Loan tenure" box
the monthly EMI, total interest and total payment should match my own calculation

name: LoanLens UI - EMI calculator

description:
The dashboard summarises the loan book. Every expected figure comes from the
  suite's own reading of the data file (framework/oracles/loan-book.ts), never
  from the app.

elements.name: The dashboard loads with its heading, key figures and recent loans

steps.name: I open the LoanLens dashboard
the LoanLens screen heading should be "Portfolio overview"
the browser tab title should be "Portfolio overview · LoanLens"
the dashboard key figures should match the loan book
the recent disbursements table should list the 5 most recently disbursed loans
I capture evidence "dashboard"

elements.name: The principal-by-type donut shows every loan type's principal

steps.name: I open the LoanLens dashboard
the "Principal by loan type" donut should draw one non-zero slice per loan type with the loan book's principal
the "Principal by loan type" donut's legend should total the loan book's principal

elements.name: The main navigation opens the EMI calculator

steps.name: I open the LoanLens dashboard
I follow the "EMI calculator" link in the main navigation
the address bar should show "/calculator"
the LoanLens screen heading should be "EMI calculator"

name: LoanLens UI - Portfolio dashboard
